scope.menuPathObserved: Road to Glory > Create Player > Player > Appearance > Head & Skin > Head Template
scope.scopeBoundary: This package intentionally creates records only for Face 1 through Face 29. It does not assert that 29 is the complete Head Template count.
scope.excludedReason: Outside Prompt 87 ingestion scope; no production or verified records are created for later labels in this package.

context.platformNote: Evidence is from Xbox screen recordings; exact console model remains unknown.

observationPolicy.labelPolicy: Visible labels are recorded only when the option is selected on the Head Template menu.
observationPolicy.thumbnailPolicy: Neighboring thumbnails are not treated as catalog records.
observationPolicy.appearanceObservationPolicy: Hair, facial hair, eye-black, and obstruction notes are researcher visual observations for capture QA only; they are not native game option labels.
observationPolicy.verificationPolicy: Records remain NOT_VERIFIED until the formal second-person verification workflow is complete.
observationPolicy.productionGatePolicy: These records cannot enable production recommendations.
